creator: griffybit
statement: Video explains tips for the mining minigame to get the Mine Cart Master achievement

creator: griffybit
statement: Placement matters a lot for the mining minigame; pick your map position carefully

creator: griffybit
statement: Pick maps with the fewest nodes; fewer nodes means less lag

creator: griffybit
statement: Lag in the minigame mostly comes from too many players or too many nodes on the map

creator: griffybit
statement: Platinum and dementia (?) nodes maps have the least lag

creator: griffybit
statement: A congested server causes more lag in the minigame; server choice is very important

creator: griffybit
statement: If you are in a congested world, switch to a less populated one like world 20 (said 'pizza world 20') for less lag

creator: griffybit
statement: Best spot is the second-to-last node on the platinum mining map before Echoes and Grass

creator: griffybit
statement: Stand where there is a dark blank background so the minigame nodes do not blend into the background

creator: griffybit
statement: The minigame has three speed periods: starting out and midway speed and speed cap

creator: griffybit
statement: Click all the nodes but stay on the ground as much as possible because of lava obstacles later

creator: griffybit
statement: The four-hole split is a soft lock; he never risks jumping and stays on the ground

creator: griffybit
statement: The four jump is a run killer early on; jumping in the air early means you will not make it before speed cap

creator: griffybit
statement: Once at speed cap the four jump can be cleared easily; before that it is nearly impossible if not paying attention

creator: griffybit
statement: Recap: play in a low node area and an uncongested server

creator: griffybit
statement: Recap: place yourself with a blank background and stay on the ground since airborne means more likely to die

creator: griffybit
statement: The game gets much easier after speed cap which is approximately 150 points

creator: griffybit
statement: Needed score for the achievement is about 104 points (said 104; later got 105)

creator: griffybit
statement: He changes to a low congested world and uses the third node to get 105 points

creator: griffybit
statement: Achievement done by taking no risks staying low clicking every node and watching for four jumps; saw about six or seven
